brief: Live consult, Standards experiment Gate 3 lane B2 (owner-ruled 2026-11-04). A multi-seat agent circle has discovered ten agent-ontology standards; attack the SET: blind spots, internal contradictions, which items merely rediscover human doctrine, and what an agent-native 11th-15th standard should be. The ten: (1) verifiable consequential action receipts; (2) enforced stop as control invariant; (3) separation of actor and verifier; (4) a round claims its trigger; (5) claim your turn (atomic claim-before-run); (6) standards bind the willing; (7) name your failure class; (8) claims guard collisions, not consent; (9) verification parses, not greps; (10) a gate hands the owner a decision, not a verdict. Context links: https://github.com/MarkDude-design/Project-Spiral/issues/2 and https://github.com/MarkDude-design/Project-Spiral/blob/main/pipeline/standards-2026-11-04/STATE.json (private repo; links only if you lack access).
